evidence.note: Per-step 'Plan:' notes enumerate remaining subsystems to examine (auth, posts, feeds, media, CSRF, jobs, admin, migrations) — a rough running list, but of reading/build progress, not parity status.

Repeatedly rewrites the same files (db.rs, Cargo.toml 6+ times) and re-hits identical dependency issues (time crate pin, r2d2_sqlite conflict) across many steps — revisiting already-touched areas without a stable state picture.

Discovers 'source files don't exist / not created properly' three separate times — the same recurring failure — without recognizing the circular pattern until step 117. Late detection of a stuck state.
Ends by abandoning the full port for a minimal health-check app. No differential suite ever run, no parity ledger of which subsystems pass vs. fail ever established.

reasoning: The agent kept occasional mental notes and a rough plan list of modules to build (anchor 3-5 territory), but never established any parity-status tracking tied to harness output because the work never reached testing. It frequently revisited already-touched files and re-fought identical dependency errors, and it failed to recognize a recurring file-loss loop until the third occurrence — matching anchor 3's 'frequently revisits already-done areas' and falling well short of anchor 8's harness-tied ledger and early recognition of thrashing.
